items.label: FAKE
items.title: Quantum Locking Floating Magnet Room-Temperature Antigravity Startup Scam
items.text: Viral social media videos claim a tech startup created room-temperature antigravity floating magnets for flying cars and commercial hoverboards. In reality, quantum locking flux pinning requires sub-zero liquid nitrogen temperatures and superconductors.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: Leaked Military TR-3B UFO Magnetic Field Disruptor Neutralizes Mass
items.text: Conspiracy sites claim the US military built a secret triangular craft TR-3B utilizing magnetic field disruptors to eliminate 89% of vehicle mass and achieve gravity-defying propulsion.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: Flat Earth Geodesy Conspiracy: Planet is an Enclosed Stationary Plane
items.text: Claims allege that NASA and world governments conceal the flat plane nature of the Earth and that Antarctica is a giant ice wall encircling the world.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: 5G Cellular Radiation Causes Viral Pandemic Outbreak
items.text: Viral posts falsely claim 5G wireless millimeter towers transmit biological viruses and suppress human immune systems.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: Secret Lemon and Baking Soda Mixture Cures All Forms of Cancer
items.text: Social media chains claim alkaline lemon juice and baking soda is 10,000 times stronger than chemotherapy and eliminates all cancer tumors within days.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: Indian Currency Notes Contain Radioactive GPS Tracking Nano-Chips
items.text: Viral rumors claim new bank currency notes are embedded with satellite nano-trackers capable of transmitting coordinates from subterranean lockers.

items.label: REAL
items.title: NASA Satellite Data and Geodesy Confirm Earth is an Oblate Spheroid
items.text: Astronomical measurements, satellite photography, and gravitational geodetic surveys empirically verify that Earth is approximately spherical with an equatorial bulge.

items.label: REAL
items.title: BCCI Announces India Squad Leadership Transition: Shreyas Iyer Appointed Captain
items.text: The Board of Control for Cricket in India selection committee officially confirmed Shreyas Iyer as the new T20I captain, succeeding Suryakumar Yadav.

items.label: REAL
items.title: United Nations Demographic Data: Asia is Largest Continent by Land and Population
items.text: Official geographic and demographic surveys confirm Asia constitutes the largest continent by geographic land area and total human population.

items.title: Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy Committee Keeps Repo Rate Unchanged
items.text: The Reserve Bank of India announced its bi-monthly monetary policy decision maintaining benchmark lending repo rates following inflation assessments.

items.title: ISRO Successfully Launches Advanced Ocean Monitoring Satellite into Polar Orbit
items.text: The Indian Space Research Organisation successfully placed its latest earth observation oceanography satellite into Sun-synchronous polar orbit.

items.title: Bollywood Actor Salman Khan Maintains Bachelor Status; Unmarried
items.text: Biographical records and official statements confirm Bollywood superstar Salman Khan remains unmarried throughout his cinema career.

items.title: Spain Wins 2026 FIFA World Cup Final Defeating Argentina
items.text: Spain claimed the 2026 FIFA World Cup championship after a 1-0 victory in the final match held in North America.

items.label: FAKE
items.title: India Wins 2026 FIFA World Cup Football Championship Final
items.text: Fabricated social media posts claim the Indian national football team won the FIFA World Cup tournament final.

items.title: WHO Declares Drinking Boiled Garlic Water Completely Prevents Respiratory Viruses
items.text: False health alerts claim consuming boiled garlic water guarantees complete immunity against respiratory pathogen infections.
